notes.title: MERRY CHRISTMAS!
notes.content:
It is the 24th once again, and that means... [b]Christmas![/b] [i](Atleast for Norwegians)[/i]
Hope this years has been great, and that the next one will be too!

Thanks again for the support on Little helper, this year we were able to reach over 37,000 downloads which is over 17k more than last year, [b]INSANE[/b]!
Have an excellent time with family and friends [b]<3[/b]

Cheers,
Vander/lilleBror
